title: GameCompleted
description: Published async contract on room.lifecycle.events. Producer: room-gameplay, via outbox-relay. Consumers: ranking, analytics-workers. Traces to docs/architecture/10-api-event-catalog.md. The sample it validates is generated by the producer's own test (services/room-gameplay ContractSampleTest), not written by hand. Envelope metadata travels as CloudEvents headers, not in the body: the event's identity is ce-id = roomId:sequenceNumber, and the correlation id is ce-correlationid. Additive-only evolution — adding a field means updating this schema in the same commit, which is deliberate: additionalProperties is false so a leaked field (a seed, say) fails the check.
